messages:
Rhea Malhotra: AlderBio wants a POC to migrate from MeridianAPI -> Redwood. Key constraints: exact streaming frame parity (they use 'zig'/'zag' frames + checksum meta), matching token accounting (they bill pertoken with a per-request provenance id), FHIR passthrough, EU-only processing, BYOK HSM option, signed DPA + 24mo audit logs. 3-week trial target. Who can lead tech?
Owen Park: I can lead. Will build a Meridian-compatible facade exposing the same endpoints and SSE events. Need a sample of their streaming payloads (esp checksum/meta) and their tokenizer edgecases.
Miguel Santos: Sales: they want migration credit + short-term price parity. Customer asked for 60-day cost parity and help with engineering integration. Proposing 30% credit first 60 days + a $15k engineering offset.
Tara Bose (SE): Important blocker: Meridian streams include a per-token provenance id in a separate 'meta' frame after every 50 tokens. Their client rejects responses missing that sequence. We must replicate exact framing and ordering.
Owen Park: Example test curl to mimic Meridian endpoint:```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -X POST \
  https://poc.redwood.local/meridian/v1/complete \
  -H "X-Tenant-ID: alder-001" \
  -d '{"prompt":"<clinical note>","stream":true}'
```
Miguel Santos: Pricing note  can we offer a migration trial price floor? I suggest we guarantee total token unit price within 5% of their current bill for 60 days and apply migration credit.
Tara Bose (SE): Tokenization delta: Meridian uses a custom BPE variant; small differences cause off-by-one token truncation. Plan: run token-diff on their 2k prompt corpus and surface per-prompt token deltas in the report. Also add a safe-truncation shim that uses Meridian's tokenizer when needed.
SecBot: Security: SOC2 Type II confirmed. KMS: AWS KMS/GCP CMEK supported; Private supports PKCS#11 HSM BYOK with ops addendum. EU-only processing supported on Private control plane. DPA addendum required for 24mo immutable logs. Provide DPO contact.
Owen Park: Streaming shim pseudo:```js
// map Redwood frames to Meridian zig/zag/meta/checksum sequence
function emitFrames(tokens, meta) {
  for (let i=0;i<tokens.length;i++) {
    send('data: ' + JSON.stringify({zig: tokens[i]}));
    if (i % 50 === 49) send('event: meta\n data: ' + JSON.stringify({prov_id: meta.blockId[i/50], checksum: meta.ck[i/50]}));
  }
  send('event: zag\n data: {}\n\n');
}
```
Miguel Santos: Evaluation metrics from AlderBio: token-cost delta, latency P95, clinical intent F1 on 800 labeled prompts, hallucination incidents on worst-10 clinical cases, tokenizer mismatch rate, and schema pass-rate for FHIR payloads.
Owen Park: I'll stand up a small Dedicated eu-west slice and pin model rdx-3.0-small for the POC. infra-bot: request queued. ETA 48h.
infra-bot: Dedicated eu-west slice requested (ticket #61234). Estimated ready in ~48 hours.
Tara Bose (SE): Legal/contract asks: rollback plan if regressions > 1.5% on critical intents. Proposal: canary 10% traffic for 72h with auto-fallback to Meridian on regression signal plus a 30-day remediation SLA.
legal-bot: Noted. We will prepare a POC SLA + DPA addendum. Need AlderBio legal contact and expected retention policy confirmation.
Rhea Malhotra: Timeline proposed: Week0 infra+shim; Week1 streaming parity smoke and tokenizer diffs; Week2 evaluation runs + mitigation; Week3 decision + contracting.
Miguel Santos: I'll draft pricing + migration credit language and attach for review by EOD tomorrow.
Owen Park: Action items for eng: 1) implement endpoint façade + header passthrough (X-Org, X-Provenance), 2) SSE frame emulator with exact event sequencing, 3) tokenizer diff tool + safe-truncation fallback, 4) run smoke tests with infra and produce comparison snapshots.
SecBot: Reminder: attach completed security questionnaire and DPO contact. We'll also need a short architecture diagram for the Private deployment (control plane separation, HSM location).
Tara Bose (SE): Blocker  client-side library expects a 'checksum' meta that is SHA256 over the last 512 tokens string. We'll need to reproduce the same bytes. Owen, can we compute that deterministically from Redwood outputs?
Owen Park: Yes — we'll implement canonical byte serialization before checksum and include it in meta frames. Also will record per-token provenance mapping in logs for audit.
Miguel Santos: Can we schedule a customer demo on Thursday? I can present pricing + high-level migration approach.
Rhea Malhotra: Let's do Thu 14:00 CET. I'll invite AlderBio stakeholders. Marking this thread as the POC single source of truth. Upload sample frames and tokenizer corpus when received.
Tara Bose (SE): Confirmed. I'll bring a draft of the security answers and the tokenizer diff plan to the demo.
Owen Park: I'll aim to have infra and an initial shim running by Friday for the smoke demo.
Miguel Santos: Great. I'll post the pricing draft and migration credit terms shortly. :thumbsup:
Rhea Malhotra: Thanks team  closing out initial planning. Will update with artifacts as they land.
